segments.title: April
segments.text: Hello Pop-up! April is our birthday month. Nine years of Physique 57, and the theme is Cloud Nine: a party in four acts, eight offers, and more confetti than is strictly sensible.

segments.title: ₹1.52L
segments.text: So, the number. Our April target for Pop-up is 1.52 lakh rupees. That's 44 per cent up on last April. A stretch, but a friendly one.

segments.title: 4 streams
segments.text: Where does it come from? Renewals lead the way with 66,800 rupees. That's 4 of every 10 rupees. Then new clients 60,000, comebacks 23,600, and everything else 1,500. Our existing members carry this month, so every renewal conversation matters.

segments.title: 40 buyers
segments.text: Behind the number are people: 469 leads, 122 trials, and 40 buyers, with about 33 per cent of trials converting. The trial class is where this month is won. Warm welcome, clear next step, every time.

Here's where the offers come in. Five offers carry 1.02 lakh rupees, which is 67 per cent of our target. The rest comes from full-price sales, so the offers are a boost, not a crutch. Let's meet them.

segments.title: The 9:09 Panic Attack
segments.text: First up, the nine-oh-nine panic attack. The limited nine-class pack. That's 2 buyers, for 13,000 rupees.
segments.notes: Everyone: members, pack buyers and newcomers.

segments.title: Plus One, Plus Nine
segments.text: Next, Plus One, Plus Nine. Bring a friend who joins and get nine extra days. That's 1 buyer, for 5,900 rupees.
segments.notes: Current members bringing a never-been friend.

segments.title: Party Crasher Pass
segments.text: Then, for newcomers, the Party Crasher Pass. Three classes for nine ninety-nine, party class included, credited against a first month. That's 3 buyers, for 14,700 rupees.

segments.title: Faking Your Own Death Didn’t Work
segments.text: Also this month, for lapsed members, Faking Your Own Death Didn't Work. They get an obituary postcard, which is also their ticket to the candle-lit Séance Class. That's 2 buyers, for 14,500 rupees.

segments.title: Spin Class (Literally)
segments.text: And finally, for renewals, Spin Class. Literally. Renew in April and spin the Wheel of Nine. That's 7 buyers, for 53,600 rupees.
segments.notes: Members renewing 1 Month or a 12-class pack.

segments.title: 4 weeks
segments.text: How does the month run? Week one, every offer goes live and the team knows them by heart. Week two, anniversary week: the wheel, the plank-off, Barre-stie day and the nine-oh-nine panic attack. Week three, obituary postcards, the Séance Class, the Club Nine unveiling and nine at nine on the eighteenth. Week four, the Throwback Reunion, the Golden Glute Awards, and a midnight lock-in on the thirtieth.

segments.title: That's the plan
segments.text: That's April at Pop-up. 1.52 lakh rupees, five offers, and 40 buyers to welcome. Nine years in, and honestly? We've never looked better.
